headline: Obama order keeps a set of existing federal advisory committees running for another period.
what_it_does: This order continues, or sets up again, a group of federal advisory committees that would otherwise have expired. These committees give advice to the President and federal agencies on specific topics. Orders like this are usually issued every two years, and this one likely extended the committees to September 30, 2017. No abstract was provided, so the specific committees and any other changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the listed federal advisory committees
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving and meeting instead of having their committees end.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and the White House
who_it_affects.how: They keep receiving outside advice from these committees.
